name: claude-qa-skills
description: QA skills for Claude Code: fan out parallel sessions over git worktrees and drive them from any issue tracker; review PRs for edge cases and file each gap as a gated ticket.

plugins.name: claude-fleet
plugins.description: Run N isolated Claude Code sessions in parallel, one git worktree each, driven by tickets from Linear, Jira, GitHub Issues, Asana or Trello (or none). /fleet works tickets; /fleet-check reviews PRs and files gated tickets for it. Windows, macOS and Linux.
